title: SWF: RemoveObject2 tag (tag 28) for removed layers
description: Test that layers that have content in early frames but end before the timeline end produce RemoveObject2 (tag 28) at the frame where the layer disappears. Verify: (1) tag 28 appears at the frame after the last content frame, (2) tag 28 body has only depth UI16 (2 bytes), (3) depth matches the original PlaceObject2 depth, (4) RemoveObject2 does NOT appear for layers that span the full timeline.
